rows.timing: 提交後；本次不受新破綻影響
rows.value: 無傷害數字；建立本人破綻

rows.value: 建立防禦準備，不補SP、不回血

rows.origin: 主動格擋決策的新組合，非來源已證完整能力
rows.counterexample: 只舉盾/閃避/同一接觸的剩餘傷害不能用新準備

rows.goal: 攻擊：盾擊打開收招窗口
rows.condition: sword+shield; target has own B1; SP can pay C_A
rows.timing: 提交盾擊及額外付款成功後
rows.value: 開收招窗口；不回溯增加本次盾擊傷害

rows.counterexample: 打有別人破綻的B不成；付款不足不吞標記、不開窗口

rows.goal: 攻擊：選擇高耐力重擊收招
rows.timing: 本次傷害提交前只讀既有窗口；成功後消耗
rows.state: consume owner+target+A1 only after accepted hit
rows.cost_cd: 原生重擊成本仍在；SP snapshot扣原生成本前後待證；無額外成本/CD提案
rows.origin: 來源Cross Cut條件倍率；SP函數為新組合
rows.counterexample: 取消/未命中不吞；盾擊不是此事件；未證消費時點則不能承諾實現

rows.goal: 防禦：保留準備擋下一擊
rows.condition: sword+shield; own B2 active; positive valid resource domain
rows.timing: 下一筆受傷扣HP前；成功後消耗
rows.value: damage / (1+F_guard(n,SP ratio)); guard>=0, no added cap
rows.state: consume own B2 after damage commit
rows.cost_cd: 無額外付款提案；代價是放棄D2消耗同一準備的機會
rows.origin: 條件減傷靈感Resilience；函數與next-hit為新提案
rows.counterexample: 同一block交易不吃B2；環境/自傷不自動涵蓋；未知SPmax不生效

rows.goal: 防禦：主動花準備壓制敵人
rows.condition: sword+shield; own B2 active; SP can pay C_D
rows.timing: 盾擊提交與付款成功後；後續攻擊才受削弱
rows.state: consume own B2; owner+target+D2 refresh, no strength accumulation
rows.cost_cd: SP C_D; owner+D2 CD_D; values unapproved
rows.origin: Clash of Champions輸出削弱靈感；擋後盾擊新組合
rows.counterexample: 先被D1消耗就無D2；法術/持續傷害範圍未定不能一概宣稱降低

rows.goal: 輔助：替受壓隊友預留護援
rows.condition: 有合資格友軍；HP ratio <= H_low; MP can pay C_S1

rows.value: recipient下一筆合資格受傷由F_guard決定減傷；與D1共用函數概念、參數各自校準
rows.state: giver+recipient+S1 refresh T_ward; consumed by S2 or next accepted hostile hit
rows.cost_cd: MP C_S1; owner+S1 CD_S1; 無target不扣款、不啟CD

rows.counterexample: 不砍隊友；死者/遠者/未知關係排除；次擊與S2競爭只准先提交者消耗

rows.goal: 輔助：攻擊追打隊友的敵人以救援
rows.filter: normal or power; native hostile target
rows.condition: sword+shield; candidate recipient holds own S1; target combat-target snapshot == recipient; MP can pay C_S2
rows.recipient: 符合條件且持有本人護援者；沿S1同率選法；含自己
rows.timing: 劍命中提交後；合成治療不是新hit
rows.value: heal=F_heal(n,recipient missing HP); no overheal banking
rows.state: consume own giver+recipient+S1 after heal+payment accepted
rows.cost_cd: MP C_S2; owner+S2 CD_S2; amounts unapproved
rows.origin: 低血急救與支援定位靈感；攻敵救援全鏈是新提案
rows.counterexample: 來源A不能消耗B護援；敵人沒在追該友軍就不觸發；0有效治療不付款/不消耗

rows.goal: 輔助：護援先抵下一筆傷害
rows.condition: recipient has eligible S1 from giver; transaction not S1 creation; giver state still valid
rows.recipient: 受援者，可為隊友/受控召喚物/自己
rows.timing: 扣HP前讀既有護援；accepted damage成功提交後消耗
rows.value: damage/(1+F_guard_support(n)); 不讀受援者SP；和D1相遇的合併提案見model
rows.state: 選最早到期giver實例；consume exact giver+recipient+S1；若S2先消耗則無效
rows.cost_cd: 不另收MP提案，S1已支付；不啟動S1或S2的CD
rows.origin: Bastion支援靈感；next-hit消耗為新組合
rows.counterexample: 同一block不能新建立即抵傷；兩筆incoming不能消耗同一實例；S2與S3先成功提交者取得
